scope: Additive experimental FFCS color-only C ABI. Existing full-photo implementations remain textually unchanged. This is portable CPU validation, not Apple compilation or GPU/device validation.

api.name: ffcs_process_linear_rgb_color_only
api.input: Dense RGB Float32, finite linear-sRGB [0,1], nonzero pixel_count
api.output: Dense display-linear sRGB RGBA Float32, alpha exactly 1
api.blur_stage: No blur stage exists in the source pipeline.
retained_stages: original XH2S LUT and axis/channel convention
api.exposure: Not baked; caller handles admitted input upstream. Existing numeric LUT approximation evidence evaluated EV=0 only.

oracles: Original render tone_curve callback snapshot, then float(decode(channel))
Original ffcs_process_linear_rgb with grain=0 and sharp=0 in a test-owned context copy
Prior tool-private mobilePixel extraction with grain=0 and sharp=0 in a test-owned context copy
other_checks: Four simultaneous batches on a shared context equal a single batch bit-for-bit
Full-photo result before and after color-only call unchanged
Null pointers, zero count, short input/output counts, size overflow, forward/backward/same-base overlap rejected
Nonfinite and out-of-domain input at end of buffer rejected before any output writes
Extra count capacity ignored outside required input/output ranges
